remarks: ONE LEVEL LIVING! Newer, Spacious & Privately located in Desirable Palmer Square - Mere Steps and you're on the Path to the popular public Golf Course! Enjoy life in a Pet Friendly community with economic gas heat, central air + No ADDITIONAL FEES! This well appointed, Sun-Drenched, Beautiful home with private entrance & extra Windows also offers designer features such as: Laminate Flooring, Designer Kitchen W/Stainless Steel Appliances & Granite Counter tops. Enjoy an open living/dining area. Come see this Cheerful, Bright Space, wonderfully situated within the complex - it's quite private! In-Unit Washer/Dryer located in the apartment closet. Meticulously maintained community features: On-Site Management, 24-Hour Security & Parking for 2-Cars. Pets are welcome with the following guidelines 2 Dogs  35 Lbs., 1 Dog 60 lbs., or 1-dog + 1-Cat or 2-Cats OK. $300 fully refundable pet deposit per pet required. Palmer Square is a No Smoking Community. Interested parties please complete a Palmer Square application uploaded in supplements, and supply a credit check through Applyconnect only.
